_comment: 來賓端與訪後信用語。開放建議欄位的措辭必須是請益語氣（設計原則 3），不可改成滿意度用語。ko／ja 譯文請母語者校閱。

en.welcome: Welcome to the Green Health Research Center
en.center: Green Health Research Center · NTU College of Bioresources and Agriculture
en.leave_email_title: Would you like today's slides and papers?
en.leave_email_body: Leave your email and we will send you the slides, the papers of the laboratories you found most interesting, and the contact details of their leads.
en.note_optional: Anything you would like us to send or arrange (optional)
en.thanks: Thank you. We will be in touch.
en.now_in_room: Fallback: tell us which room you are in now
en.respond_intro: Three short questions. Your advice is worth more to us than anything else.
en.cooperate: Which laboratories would you like to explore further collaboration with?
en.ask_better: From your perspective, what should we be doing better?
en.anonymous: Send anonymously — we do not record who wrote this.

zh.center: 綠色健康研究中心 · 臺大生物資源暨農學院
zh.leave_email_title: 想要今天的簡報與論文嗎？
zh.leave_email_body: 留下信箱，我們會寄上簡報、您最感興趣的研究室的論文，以及老師的聯絡方式。

ko.leave_email_title: 오늘 발표 자료와 논문을 받아 보시겠습니까?

ko.cooperate: 어느 실험실과 후속 공동연구를 논의해 보고 싶으십니까?

ko.ask_better: 선생님의 전문적 관점에서, 저희 센터가 더 잘해야 할 부분은 무엇일까요?
ko.anonymous_note: 선택하시면 성함, 이메일, 주소가 답변과 함께 저장되지 않습니다.
